{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
df_loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = df_loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers (after removing QA outliers): {mean_revenue}")"}
